name: @swag-money/vscode
description: Show a signed wait-state ad in the status bar. For VS Code, Cursor, and Windsurf. Does not change CSP.

commands.title: Swag-Money: Show a signed ad in the status bar

swagMoney.apiUrl.description: Swag-Money API origin. The extension never loads scripts from this origin.

swagMoney.installId.description: Install id from the developer dashboard.

swagMoney.devicePrivateKey.description: Base64url Ed25519 device private key. Keep this in user settings, not in the repo.

swagMoney.pinnedPublicKey.description: Pinned server Ed25519 public key, base64url. Not read from the ad response.

swagMoney.surface.description: Auction surface this editor reports. The extension still only writes its own status-bar item.
